hooks.name: Deploy Gate - Block deploy skill activation
hooks.description: Forces IDE confirmation popup before activating any skill that might trigger deploy. The model cannot bypass this popup.

action.command: zsh -c 'INPUT=$(cat); SKILL=$(echo "$INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get(\"toolInput\",{}).get(\"name\",\"\"))" 2>/dev/null || echo ""); if [[ "$SKILL" == "deploy-to-vercel" ]]; then echo "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"permissionDecision\":\"ask\",\"permissionDecisionReason\":\"⛔ Deploy a producción requiere tu aprobación. ¿Permitir deploy?\"}}"; fi; exit 0'
